## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 6, 2026 - Nov 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _MadMardigan88_, Oct 31, 2026, 1/5: "This app felt helpful for a while, but the novelty wore off and now it’s mostly just another task to complete each day. But the main reason I will no longer be using this app is because of its celebration of witchcraft, as well as the mental illness of gender confusion. These do not align with what is Good and True, so I can no longer support this app or allow it into my life. I have canceled my subscription and am deleting this app, and will be searching for a new app that is not only helpful for organizing my tasks, but is honoring to Almighty God."
            2. _Haybale669_, Oct 30, 2026, 2/5: "A friend sent this to me, saying it was super adorable and I should give it a try. I was actually excited to check it out. It looked cute and I need something to help motivate me, so why not, right? However, I absolutely hate apps that do this. They have you open the app, create your character/critter or whatever, set up your profile, enter your name and information, take a whole quiz and THEN tell you need to pay for a subscription to access the app and its contents. And it looks like they’re pushing a yearly subscription too. Who is actually paying for all this? 🤣 I won’t even be taking my free 7 DAY trial because that’s exactly how they get people. You forget to cancel, and suddenly you’re being charged for something you didn’t even intend to pay for. So nope! I’ll be deleting the app. Just wanted to share my experience before I go.😂"
            3. _Seibzehn_, Sep 13, 2026, 2/5: "Finch initially makes a friendly and well thought-out impression. The concept can be particularly helpful for people who have difficulties with motivation, routines, procrastination or their general well-being. What I find all the more disappointing is the way they try to sell a subscription during onboarding. After you have just told the app in which personal areas you need support, an emotionally designed offer appears with statements such as “Biggest discount ever”, “One-time offer” and finally even “Offer expires when you exit this screen!”. I was offered a 50% discount and €39.99 per year instead of €79.99. The actual price and the automatic extension are stated transparently - that is not my criticism. What I find problematic is the artificial time pressure and the fear of losing a supposedly unique offer. With a regular app, aggressive paywall marketing would bother me. I find it particularly inappropriate for a self-care app. Ultimately, the target group can include people who are looking for support with ADHD, anxiety, depression, impulse control, motivation or self-organization. In my opinion, this is where you should handle FOMO and psychological selling pressure particularly responsibly. I don't want to describe the app itself as dubious. I actually like the concept. However, for me, the type of marketing does not match the trusting and supportive claim of a self-care app. It would also be desirable to have a complete German translation of the app and a lifetime purchase option for users who deliberately do not want to take out another permanent subscription. I think a fair one-off payment would be very appropriate, especially for an app that is intended to help you build routines over the long term."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 28, 2026 - Nov 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, May 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _Hmf2264_, Nov 4, 2026, 5/5: "I was an avid app user for over 500 days. Growing up in the Webkinz era, the “responsibility” of taking care of my Finch kept me checking in daily. It became a fun and sort of nostalgic way to help me keep up daily tasks that seemed daunting. I loved the ability to personalize my to-do list. Through trial and error, I was able to establish a routine that worked for me. Over time, this routine became something I settled into without even realizing it. I paused my progress in the app due to going on vacation and never got around to getting back on it due to storage issues on my phone. My routine remained the same and I had finally become more efficient in taking care of my home and daily tasks without any additional help. The habits stuck and have stayed. A year and a half on the app made a truly positive impact in my day-to-day. I now have a healthier relationship with cleaning and feel self-sufficient in how to tackle my day-to-day."
            3. _67susy:)!_, Nov 3, 2026, 5/5: "This app is AMAZING!! Some people say it glitch (which it doesn’t). And I’ve read some reviews, but some people in the reviews need to get over that there are PRIDE supporting stuff, if it bothers them that much then they should just delete it. Bc it’s really supporting and helpful for the people who do support it!! P.S. So Finch dose support PRIDE/LGBTQ for anyone who cares or supports that stuff🤗"
<!--/ir-theme-->
